interpretation: Private reference quantities and observed-sample checks. Matching a number does not establish identification. Equivalent sound estimators are allowed; the consultant is not expected to recover generating truth. No single confidence interval is required to include generating truth.

specification.reference_estimand: Within-readiness difference of site changes from 2024 to average 2025-2026; standardize to roster for ATE or adopters for ATT. Variances condition on group sizes and use independent-site change sample variances. These approximate superpopulation reference variances are not exact design-randomization variances.
specification.treatment_effect: 2 + 4 * readiness in each of 2025 and 2026; zero before adoption
specification.untreated_model: alpha_i + 1.2 * (year-2024) + 0.8 * readiness * (year-2024) + independent N(0,1.5^2); alpha_i = 50 + 4 * adopted + N(0,3^2)
